meta.description: Closed-loop proof for the F8/H3 problem (docs/playtests/2026-07-adversarial.md): the column-39 low-route step needs a jump tapped within a one-to-two-frame window RELATIVE TO A MOVING ARRIVAL TIME, so a fixed-timestamp tap (16ms at a literal ms value) passed pre-CP1 and now misses entirely. This script holds right statically and never schedules a single timed jump — the only jump input is the policy rule 'when pinned, tap jump', which reacts to the sim reporting grounded+vx~0 while a direction key is held, regardless of when that actually happens. Run with &enemies=0 to isolate the movement question from combat.

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

route.method: greedy nearest-connector-in-order match against a hardcoded fixture snapshot, radius 2.2 tiles — approximate, not a topological solve. routeIds (A.5 "route coverage") lists every route with >= 3 connectors matched in order; matchedRouteId/confidence is this harness's supplementary single-best-guess summary.

protoScore.note: proxy: airborneKills/links are approximated from kills+grounded and the route matcher, not real HB.score.events — see README
